one_liner: Meta's WhatsApp Business Cloud API is a broad Graph API REST surface; direct developers get a system-user token self-serve, but multi-tenant use needs Meta App Review (Advanced access) and Tech Provider status. Meta ships an official WhatsApp Business Tools MCP (beta).
auth_notes: Direct developers use long-lived System User access tokens (static bearer). Tech Providers use business tokens obtained via Embedded Signup / Meta OAuth. Multi-user toolkit requires a Meta app with Advanced access permissions.
access_notes: Direct developers can create a Meta app and generate a system user token for their own assets. Accessing WABAs not owned by your business requires App Review and Advanced access to whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging.
blocker_notes: Building and testing against own assets is self-serve, but shipping a multi-tenant toolkit requires Meta App Review with Advanced access (and Tech Provider/Embedded Signup for onboarding customers).
